chunks: With this chain of transmission, from Muhammad ibn Ya'qub, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Faddal, from Ibn Bukayr, from Zurarah, from Abi 'Abd Allah عليه السلام, who said:
The woman in nifas refrains for the number of days that she used to refrain during menstruation, and she takes an additional precaution of two days.

key_terms.أَيَّامَهَا: the number of days assigned to her customary period
key_terms.النُّفَسَاءُ: a woman in the state of postnatal bleeding
key_terms.الْحَيْضِ: menstruation, used here as the reference period
key_terms.بِيَوْمَيْنِ: by two days, indicating the precautionary extension
key_terms.تَسْتَظْهِرُ: she observes additional precaution beyond the usual count

ai.seo_question: How many days does a woman in nifas refrain from acts of worship according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the duration of nifas. It states that a woman in postnatal bleeding remains seated from worship for the number of days corresponding to her usual menstrual period, then observes an additional precaution of two days.
